mapper.select: SELECT id FROM sr_english_taxonomy_term WHERE code=#{code} AND library_module='vocabulary' AND enabled=1 FOR UPDATE
SELECT id FROM sr_english_vocabulary_theme WHERE layer=#{layer} ORDER BY id LIMIT 1 FOR UPDATE

SELECT (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM sr_english_vocabulary_word) vocabulary_records, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM sr_english_vocabulary_mapping WHERE migration_status='confirmed') confirmed_records, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM sr_english_vocabulary_mapping WHERE migration_status='needs-review') review_records, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM sr_english_vocabulary_mapping WHERE migration_status='unclassified') unclassified_records, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM sr_english_grammar_lesson WHERE publish_status='PUBLISHED') grammar_lessons, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM sr_english_reading_article a WHERE a.deleted_at IS NULL AND ) world_articles, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM sr_english_writing_article a WHERE ) essays

choose.when: SELECT n.code, COUNT(DISTINCT w.id) total FROM sr_english_taxonomy_term n LEFT JOIN sr_english_taxonomy_term child ON child.id=n.id OR child.parent_id=n.id LEFT JOIN sr_english_vocabulary_topic t ON t.term_id=child.id AND child.enabled=1 LEFT JOIN sr_english_vocabulary_mapping m ON m.word_id=t.word_id AND m.migration_status='confirmed' LEFT JOIN sr_english_vocabulary_word w ON w.id=m.word_id AND EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM sr_english_vocabulary_theme source WHERE source.id=w.theme_id) WHERE n.library_module='vocabulary' AND n.enabled=1 GROUP BY n.id,n.code
choose.otherwise: SELECT n.code, COUNT(DISTINCT a.id) total FROM sr_english_taxonomy_term n LEFT JOIN sr_english_taxonomy_term child ON child.id=n.id OR child.parent_id=n.id LEFT JOIN sr_english_reading_article a ON child.enabled=1 AND (a.primary_topic_id=child.id OR EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM sr_english_reading_tag rt WHERE rt.article_id=a.id AND rt.term_id=child.id)) AND a.deleted_at IS NULL AND () WHERE n.library_module='world' AND n.enabled=1 GROUP BY n.id,n.code

mapper.select: SELECT ORDER BY w.theme_id,w.sort_order,w.id LIMIT #{limit} OFFSET #{offset}
SELECT n.code FROM sr_english_vocabulary_topic t JOIN sr_english_taxonomy_term n ON n.id=t.term_id WHERE t.word_id=#{id} ORDER BY n.sort_order,n.id
SELECT FROM sr_english_vocabulary_word w JOIN sr_english_vocabulary_mapping m ON m.word_id=w.id WHERE w.id=#{id} FOR UPDATE
mapper.update: UPDATE sr_english_vocabulary_mapping SET migration_status=#{value.migrationStatus},migration_reason=#{value.migrationReason},row_version=row_version+1 WHERE word_id=#{id} AND row_version=#{value.rowVersion}
mapper.sql: FROM sr_english_writing_article a WHERE AND LOCATE(LOWER(#{search}),LOWER(a.title)) > 0 AND JSON_CONTAINS(a.keywords_json,JSON_QUOTE(#{tag})) AND a.published_at >= CONCAT(#{month},'-01') AND a.published_at < DATE_ADD(CONCAT(#{month},'-01'),INTERVAL 1 MONTH) AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM sr_english_writing_article_tag r JOIN sr_english_taxonomy_term t ON t.id=r.term_id WHERE r.article_id=a.id AND t.dimension='GENRE' AND t.enabled=1 AND t.name=#{genre})
mapper.select: SELECT j.name,COUNT(DISTINCT a.id) total FROM sr_english_writing_article a JOIN JSON_TABLE(COALESCE(a.keywords_json,JSON_ARRAY()),'$[*]' COLUMNS(name VARCHAR(100) PATH '$')) j WHERE GROUP BY j.name ORDER BY total DESC,j.name
SELECT DATE_FORMAT(a.published_at,'%Y-%m') name,COUNT(*) total FROM sr_english_writing_article a WHERE GROUP BY name ORDER BY name DESC

SELECT t.name,COUNT(DISTINCT a.id) total FROM sr_english_writing_article a JOIN sr_english_writing_article_tag r ON r.article_id=a.id JOIN sr_english_taxonomy_term t ON t.id=r.term_id WHERE AND t.dimension='GENRE' AND t.enabled=1 GROUP BY t.id,t.name ORDER BY MIN(t.sort_order),t.id
